question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

'tout de suite'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Immediately**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"tout de suite"** is borrowed from French and translates directly to **"immediately" or "right away"** in English. (तुरंत)
 
• This idiom is used to emphasize urgency or quick action.
 
• **Example:** When I asked her to join me, she said she'd be there tout de suite.
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom "tout de suite" is **Immediately** (तुरंत).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Immediately**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Slowly** (धीरे) - Refers to doing something at a slow pace or gradually. 
 
 
• **Example:** He walked slowly to enjoy the beauty of the garden.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Later** (बाद में) - Refers to doing something after some time or at a subsequent period. 
 
 
• **Example:** We can discuss the matter later when you are free.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: After the case is over** (केस खत्म होने के बाद) - Refers specifically to an action or event following the conclusion of a legal case or matter. 
 
 
• **Example:** The judge will announce the decision after the case is over.
